en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 11.Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “
Verily Allah created with His [own] hand a paradise that no eye has seen, and no creature is familiar with.
The Blessed and Exalted Lord opens it up every morning and says, ‘Increase in [your sweet smelling] fragrance, increase in [your fresh] breeze!’
So it says, ‘Successful indeed are the believers.’
That is the [interpretation of the] verse wherein Allah, the Exalted, says: No soul can imagine what delights are hidden in store for them as a reward for what they used to do (Q32:17).”
